cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Day-to-Day Duties May Include:
Providing engineering support to a manufacturing process, project or function. Evaluating manufacturing outcomes and implementing continuous improvements and cost efficiencies. Supporting NPI and new equipment/process introductions. Providing technical, engineering, validation and documentation support. Supporting engineering and project management in FAT, installation, and commissioning of the new assembly line. Supporting development of the process FMEA and control plan for the new assembly process. Completing process validations including VP, URS, IQ, OQ, PQ and associated documentation. Developing appropriate supporting documentation, SOPs and work instructions compliant with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Collaborating with product and manufacturing engineering, equipment vendors, maintenance technicians and operations leadership to troubleshoot process and equipment issues. Supporting line performance monitoring and leading practical problem solving (PPS) projects to remediate systemic issues.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or relevant field of study
2 Years of Manufacturing Engineering experience
Experience supporting manufacturing operations, troubleshooting automation equipment, and implementing process improvements
Experience with automation equipment/software
Preferred Requirements:
Experience writing and executing validations (IQ, OQ, PQ)
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value work that is useful to others and carried out with care. We believe strong organizations pay attention not only to outcomes, but also to how those outcomes affect people.

Strong command of automation equipment and software required.

cond_0070.intro: We are looking for an experienced Manufacturing Engineer to support the installation, validation, and production ramp-up of a custom automation line for the high-volume manufacture of medical devices.
cond_0070.responsibilities:
Day-to-Day Duties May Include:
Providing engineering support to a manufacturing process, project, or function.
Evaluating manufacturing outcomes and implementing continuous improvements and cost efficiencies.
Supporting NPI and new equipment/process introductions.
Providing technical, engineering, validation, and documentation support.
Supporting engineering and project management in FAT, installation, and commissioning of the new assembly line.

Experience supporting manufacturing operations, troubleshooting automation equipment, and implementing process improvements.
Experience writing and executing validations (IQ, OQ, PQ).
Experience with automation equipment/software required.
No C2C candidates.

A large part of this role involves staying in regular contact with product and manufacturing engineering teams, equipment vendors, maintenance technicians, and operations leadership to troubleshoot process and equipment issues. You will actively contribute across a busy range of engineering activities, including:
Providing engineering support to a manufacturing process, project or function.
Evaluating manufacturing outcomes and implementing continuous improvements and cost efficiencies.
Supporting NPI and new equipment/process introductions.
Providing technical, engineering, validation and documentation support.
Supporting engineering and project management in FAT, installation, and commissioning of the new assembly line.
Supporting development of the process FMEA and control plan for the new assembly process.
Completing process validations including VP, URS, IQ, OQ, PQ and associated documentation.
Developing appropriate supporting documentation, SOPs and work instructions compliant with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
Collaborating with product and manufacturing engineering, equipment vendors, maintenance technicians and operations leadership to troubleshoot process and equipment issues.
Supporting line performance monitoring and leading practical problem solving (PPS) projects to remediate systemic issues.
cond_0150.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or relevant field of study.
2 Years of Manufacturing Engineering experience.
Experience supporting manufacturing operations, troubleshooting automation equipment, and implementing process improvements.
Experience with automation equipment/software.
Preferred Requirements
Experience writing and executing validations (IQ, OQ, PQ).

cond_0180.intro: We are looking for an experienced Manufacturing Engineer to join our team, supporting the installation, validation, and production ramp-up of a custom automation line for the high-volume manufacture of medical devices.
cond_0180.responsibilities:
Day-to-Day Duties May Include:
Providing engineering support to a manufacturing process, project or function.
Working with the team to evaluate manufacturing outcomes and implement continuous improvements and cost efficiencies.
Supporting NPI and new equipment/process introductions.
Providing technical, engineering, validation and documentation support.
Coordinating with engineering and project management on FAT, installation, and commissioning of the new assembly line.
Collaborating on the development of the process FMEA and control plan for the new assembly process.
Completing process validations including VP, URS, IQ, OQ, PQ and associated documentation.
Developing appropriate supporting documentation, SOPs and work instructions compliant with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
Working alongside product and manufacturing engineering, equipment vendors, maintenance technicians and operations leadership to troubleshoot process and equipment issues.
Supporting line performance monitoring and coordinating practical problem solving (PPS) projects with the team to remediate systemic issues.
cond_0180.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or relevant field of study.
2 Years of Manufacturing Engineering experience.
Experience supporting manufacturing operations, troubleshooting automation equipment, and implementing process improvements.
Experience writing and executing validations (IQ, OQ, PQ).
Experience with automation equipment/software required.
No C2C candidates.
cond_0180.values: We value work that is useful to others and carried out with care. We believe strong organizations pay attention not only to outcomes, but also to how those outcomes affect people.

cond_0353.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0353.responsibilities:
Day-to-Day Duties May Include:
Providing engineering support to a manufacturing process, project or function. Evaluating manufacturing outcomes and implementing continuous improvements and cost efficiencies. Supporting NPI and new equipment/process introductions. Providing technical, engineering, validation and documentation support. Supporting engineering and project management in FAT, installation, and commissioning of the new assembly line. Supporting development of the process FMEA and control plan for the new assembly process. Completing process validations including VP, URS, IQ, OQ, PQ and associated documentation. Developing appropriate supporting documentation, SOPs and work instructions compliant with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Collaborating with product and manufacturing engineering, equipment vendors, maintenance technicians and operations leadership to troubleshoot process and equipment issues. Supporting line performance monitoring and leading practical problem solving (PPS) projects to remediate systemic issues.
cond_0353.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or relevant field of study required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in Manufacturing Engineering.
Proven track record supporting manufacturing operations, troubleshooting automation equipment, and implementing process improvements.
Deep knowledge of writing and executing validations (IQ, OQ, PQ).
Strong command of automation equipment and software required.

cond_0418.intro: The experienced Manufacturing Engineer will be responsible for supporting the installation, validation and production ramp up of a custom automation line for the high-volume manufacture of medical devices. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of automation processes and validation work.
cond_0418.responsibilities:
Day-to-Day Duties May Include:
Providing engineering support to a manufacturing process, project or function. Evaluating manufacturing outcomes and implementing continuous improvements and cost efficiencies. Supporting NPI and new equipment/process introductions. Providing technical, engineering, validation and documentation support. Supporting engineering and project management in FAT, installation, and commissioning of the new assembly line. Supporting development of the process FMEA and control plan for the new assembly process. Completing process validations including VP, URS, IQ, OQ, PQ and associated documentation. Developing appropriate supporting documentation, SOPs and work instructions compliant with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Collaborating with product and manufacturing engineering, equipment vendors, maintenance technicians and operations leadership to troubleshoot process and equipment issues. Supporting line performance monitoring and leading practical problem solving (PPS) projects to remediate systemic issues.

Day-to-Day Duties May Include:
Providing engineering support to a manufacturing process, project or function.
Evaluating manufacturing outcomes and working with the team to implement continuous improvements and cost efficiencies.
Supporting NPI and new equipment/process introductions.
Providing technical, engineering, validation and documentation support.
Coordinating with engineering and project management on FAT, installation, and commissioning of the new assembly line.
Collaborating on the development of the process FMEA and control plan for the new assembly process.
Completing process validations including VP, URS, IQ, OQ, PQ and associated documentation.
Developing appropriate supporting documentation, SOPs and work instructions compliant with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
Working alongside product and manufacturing engineering, equipment vendors, maintenance technicians and operations leadership to troubleshoot process and equipment issues.
Supporting line performance monitoring and coordinating with the team on practical problem solving (PPS) projects to remediate systemic issues.
cond_0549.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or relevant field of study.
2 Years of Manufacturing Engineering experience.
Experience supporting manufacturing operations, troubleshooting automation equipment, and implementing process improvements.
Experience with automation equipment/software.
Preferred Requirements:
Experience writing and executing validations (IQ, OQ, PQ).
No C2C candidates.
cond_0549.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
